summary: Spanning-tree preorder shortcuts a doubled tree walk into an open TSP tour.
description: Input is a spanning tree on indexed vertices and a start. Return a deterministic first-visit order using sorted adjacency. A malformed or nonspanning tree raises an error.

Depth-first traversal gives the first visits of the closed walk that traverses every tree edge twice. A metric distance matrix is needed to argue that shortcuts do not increase the walk's distance. This component takes linear traversal time apart from sorting the adjacency.
